scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 -d dist
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp -r public/* dist/ && cp -r src/styles dist/assets/styles && sed 's#/src/main.ts#/assets/main.js#; s#/src/styles/global.css#/assets/styles/global.css#' index.html > dist/index.html && for r in about coach athletes achievements events gallery club-life history contacts; do mkdir -p dist/$r && cp dist/index.html dist/$r/index.html; done
